[[File:Point_Nadir.jpg|thumb|Arcade on the Point Nadir's map.]]
The '''Arcade''' was located in the [[Point Nadir]], on the [[Comet/Legends|comet]] [[Resh 9376/Legends|Resh 9376]]. It was the entertainment district with a large number of [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] and taverns. It was decorated by columns, carved out of the comet's solid interior by [[Salovan Fische]]'s [[mining droid]]s. [[Smuggler/Legends|Smugglers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Spice/Legends|spice]] dealers could be commonly found in the Arcade. It was controlled by [[Anjiliac]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], as neither [[Epsis (organization)|Epsis]] nor [[Sable Dawn]] had any interest in it.<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>
